Q: Anchor build fails after redesign: unresolved import `crate` A:

This issue on GitHub describes the problem completely.

It's an anchor problem; #program macros don’t allow nested structures.
It must be handled with explicit imports only (oh, garbage namespace):

pub use instructions::dummy::*;

Q: JAVA : Looping through an unknown number of arrays A:

What parameter type will your method accept? Will it be a list of arrays, e.g. java.util.List<Object[]>? Will it be an array of arrays, e.g. Object[][]. What will be the type of the array elements? Will it be int – as in the code in your question? Will your method return the result of the manipulations it does on the argument it is invoked with? If yes, then post a sample argument and the value you want the method to return for that sample argument.
